results.question: which categories got pricier to borrow in 2025 than in 2024, going by the average agreed price on borrowings that finished?
results.sql:
SELECT 
    l.category,
    AVG(CASE WHEN d.requested_on >= '2024-07-01' AND d.requested_on < '2025-07-01' THEN d.agreed_price END) AS avg_price_2024,
    AVG(CASE WHEN d.requested_on >= '2025-07-01' AND d.requested_on < '2026-07-01' THEN d.agreed_price END) AS avg_price_2025,
    ROUND(
        (AVG(CASE WHEN d.requested_on >= '2025-07-01' AND d.requested_on < '2026-07-01' THEN d.agreed_price END) - 
         AVG(CASE WHEN d.requested_on >= '2024-07-01' AND d.requested_on < '2025-07-01' THEN d.agreed_price END)), 
        2
    ) AS price_difference
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.listings_all l ON d.item_id = l.item_id
WHERE d.deal_type = 'rental'
  AND d.status = 'completed'
  AND d.requested_on IS NOT NULL
  AND d.agreed_price IS NOT NULL
  AND d.requested_on >= '2024-07-01'
  AND d.requested_on < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY l.category
HAVING AVG(CASE WHEN d.requested_on >= '2025-07-01' AND d.requested_on < '2026-07-01' THEN d.agreed_price END) > 
       AVG(CASE WHEN d.requested_on >= '2024-07-01' AND d.requested_on < '2025-07-01' THEN d.agreed_price END)
ORDER BY price_difference DESC;
results.answer: The categories that got pricier to borrow in 2025 than in 2024 are sports_outdoors and textbooks. Sports outdoors had an average price increase of 1.46, and textbooks had an increase of 0.32.
